# Which jobs make your shoe repair shop money, and how many does the season have to sell?

> Free shoe repair shop calculator: enter heel, repair and rework prices, bench minutes, supplies, cobbler pay and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the season result. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
